title: Hold Multiple after Reversed Storage Payments — Bluegate Moving Truck Rental
content:
**Payment-risk ruling for the Bluegate Moving Truck Rental authorization hold.** The hold payment-risk multiple depends on the card on file and the renter's storage ledger — the payment reversal entries on the renter's Self-Storage Unit Rental Agreement tenant ledger:

- a debit card on file for a renter with a storage payment reversed within the last twelve months multiplies the card deposit by **1.5**;
- a credit card on file for such a renter multiplies it by **1.25**;
- a renter with no storage payment reversed in that time keeps the card deposit as it is.

## Matrix

| Card on file | Storage payment reversed within the last twelve months | Card deposit multiplied by |
|---|---|---|
| Debit card | Yes | 1.5 |
| Credit card | Yes | 1.25 |
| Debit card | No | 1 (as it is) |
| Credit card | No | 1 (as it is) |

Illustration (hypothetical): a debit card deposit of 250.00 for a renter with one storage payment reversed four months ago becomes 375.00; a credit card deposit of 150.00 for the same renter becomes 187.50. One reversal within the twelve months is enough; a reversal fourteen months back does not count.
